fields.name: slot
fields.coerce: tested as true or false; without `name`, used as a key of `cx`
fields.description: Without `name`: the slot to clear (the variant Clear). With `name`: it matters only for a `body`, `armor` or `character` cosmetic (the variant Put on).

fields.name: name
fields.coerce: a key of `T` (the sprite type of each cosmetic) and of `all_cx(player)`
fields.description: The cosmetic to put on. A true `slot` and no `name` selects the variant Clear; every other request is the variant Put on.

fields.name: slot
fields.coerce: tested as true or false, then used as a key of `cx`
fields.description: The slot to clear. Slots: `upper`, `chin`, `makeup`, `tail`, `gravestone`, `back`, `face`, `hat`, `head`, `hair`. A clear of `back` also clears `tail`; a clear of `face` also clears `makeup`. You cannot clear the skin.

list.name: Put on
list.when: Puts a cosmetic on. Its sprite type picks the slot.

fields.name: name
fields.coerce: a key of `T` (the sprite type of each cosmetic) and of `all_cx(player)`
fields.description: The cosmetic to put on. Its sprite type picks the slot (`cxtype_to_slot`, js/old_common_functions.js:135-152). A `body`, `armor` or `character` cosmetic goes to the skin when `slot` is `"skin"`. A `body` or `armor` cosmetic goes to `upper` when `slot` is `"upper"`. Each other cosmetic goes to its own slot, whatever `slot` says.

fields.name: slot
fields.description: It matters only for a `body`, `armor` or `character` cosmetic (see `name`).

rows.when: `name` is not a known cosmetic (`T[name]`), or you do not own it (`all_cx(player)`) and your `role` is not `"cx"`. A request with neither `slot` nor `name` also ends here.

responses.name: Update
responses.when: All checks pass, before the `game_response`. Also when nothing changed.
responses.summary: Your character (`u+cid`) with the new `skin` and `cx`. The server removes each `cx` entry whose sprite type does not fit its slot (`prune_cx`, js/old_common_functions.js:341-351).

responses.name: Success
responses.when: All checks pass. The server also sends it when it made no change. Examples: a `body`, `armor` or `character` cosmetic with another `slot`. Or a sprite type with no slot: `full`, `skin`, `animation`, `v_animation`, `emblem`.
